integrity: The proof is unrestricted. It decomposes the gap into the sum of the nontrivial proper-divisor excess and a shifted cototient, classifies composite inputs with divisor excess at most \(4\), and classifies odd composite shifted arguments with cototient at most \(5\). The finite checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the zero fiber and positive fibers \(1,2,3,4\) of \(A(n)=\sigma(n)-\varphi(n+2)\). It does not classify higher fibers or resolve the infinitude of the zero fiber, which is the twin-prime problem.
title: A sharp four-unit stability gap for \(\sigma(n)-\varphi(n+2)\)
